summary: AliceBlue's Order Status Feed: an order open, partly filled and complete, one rejected with the RMS text, an NFO stop-loss order cancelled; symbols from the master by the broker symbol.

notes: Both send AliceBlue's product code as it comes (INTRADAY, LONGTERM, NRML), not OpenAlgo's MIS, CNC, NRML (audit appendix item 9). The web's REST order book maps it (broker/aliceblue/mapping/transform_data.py reverse_map_product_type); the order stream does not, on either side. Pinned as today's behaviour.
The market socket's relay logs in too, and its frame is taken from the main socket first.
